messages:
zoe: quick huddle — finalize the newsletter + post-launch drip for Launchpad benchmark webinar. goal: convert attendees into trials and collect qual feedback.

sam: agree. propose 4-touch sequence: immediate thanks + recording, 48h tips + single CTA, 7d case study + survey, 14d demo invite. plus a weekly mini digest for non-converters.

lina: segmentation: watched >=60% (power users), watched 20-60% (warm), registered-no-show. power users -> priority SDR; warm -> nurture; no-show -> recording + highlights.

ben: subject testing: 'Top 3 takeaways', 'Watch the 10-min recap', 'How teams ship faster with the Launchpad stack'. rotate 3 variants across cohorts. A/B test 48h vs 24h send for email1.

zoe: tracking: UTM campaign=launchpad_benchmark, add hidden fields: watch_pct, resources_clicked, chat_flag. ops-bot, schedule campaign please.

ops-bot: scheduled campaign "launchpad_benchmark_171600" sends: email0=1716012000, email1=1716184800, email2=1716673200, email3=1717278000.

sam: inbound routing: tag 'launchpad_power' for >=60% watchers and 'launchpad_warm' for 20-60. power -> SDR immediate queue with tag. add scoring rules: +8 resource click, +12 demo request, +6 survey yes.

lina: also create an engagement bucket for 'clicked case study' and 'opened >2 emails' — target those for a 1:many nurture.

ben: experiment idea: single-CTA vs multi-CTA in email1 small roll (3% sample). measure click-to-demo and downstream MQL rate.

zoe: deliverability: rotate subjects, throttle sends to avoid spikes, send window 9am-1pm local, suppress unsub immediately.

lina: survey for email2: 4 quick questions: (1) one-sentence value, (2) biggest blocker, (3) interest in trial (yes/no), (4) permission to contact. keep <20s.

sam: ops — include sample curl for HubSpot scheduling in #marketing-ops, and add callouts for SDR handoff mapping.

ops-bot: uploaded campaign draft to HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/campaigns/launchpad_benchmark_171600 .

zoe: owners: sam -> routing & scoring; lina -> segmentation & survey; ben -> subjects & experiments; ops -> hubspot upload + UTMs. i'll draft runbook and timeline and post in channel by EOD.

ben: adding measurement plan: track opens, CTR, recording plays, demo requests, trial starts, and lead-to-opportunity within 21 days. run stats at 90% for experiments.

zoe: perfect. thanks all — follow-ups in #marketing-ops.
